structured_output.hypothesis: If Darwin is right, nearly every oceanic island or island nation has at least one bat record, and many remote island groups have bat species recorded nowhere else.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Using a pre-listed set of 24 oceanic island countries/territories (ISO codes CV, MU, SC, KM, FJ, WS, TO, VU, NC, SB, PF, CK, FM, MH, PW, FK, SH, BM, NR, KI, TV, NU, MP, GU), at least 80% (>=20 of 24) have >=1 GBIF occurrence of Chiroptera (taxonKey 734; occurrenceStatus PRESENT, no geospatial issues) AND, among the island units with bat records, at least 40% have >=1 bat species whose GBIF records (all countries) fall only within that unit (a proxy for endemism).
structured_output.fail_criterion: Fewer than 60% (<=14 of 24) of the listed island countries/territories have any Chiroptera record, OR fewer than 15% of the island units with bat records have a single-unit-restricted bat species.
structured_output.interpretation: Darwin's 'ærial mammals' means bats (Chiroptera). 'Oceanic islands' is operationalized as a fixed list of island countries/territories that were never joined to a continent; 'almost every' means at least 80% of the list. 'Endemic' is operationalized as a species with all GBIF occurrences within one island unit, which is only a proxy because occurrence data are sparse and sampling-biased. A unit with no records is read as 'not recorded', not 'absent'. Modern reinterpretation: the list is fixed by ISO country code (the GBIF 'country' field), not by individual islands. Intermediate results (60-80% of units, or 15-40% with endemics) are inconclusive. Some absence and endemic calls would need checking against the IUCN Red List and are not decided by GBIF alone.

dataset.name: GBIF Occurrence records, order Chiroptera (taxonKey 734)
dataset.why_it_fits: The GBIF occurrence API (https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search) is open and needs no key for searches or facet counts. Chiroptera is taxonKey 734, which resolves at the landing URL to rank ORDER. Fields used: taxonKey, country, speciesKey, occurrenceStatus, basisOfRecord, hasGeospatialIssue. Facet queries (facet=speciesKey with country=XX, limit=0) give record and species counts for each island country without a bulk download.
